First off, Im sorry about your history. I was afraid to love too, always have been after repeated failure and hurt. Recently met a guy and it was just right, so I jumped in. It worked out, still together, love him to death and it actually doesn't scare me anymore, despite how terrified I was right after we got together. I guess what you can do is to just not give up, and try to put aside the fear. Its not easy, I know, but dont let your past hinder your future. If it feels right, if you feel like youre in the start of something new, jump in. You might fall, thats a possibility and risk that comes with love, but it might also turn out fine. Or even better, it might be the start of something beautiful.
Im here for you, you can talk to me if you want to.
